title: Cleopatra lived closer to the moon landing than to the pyramids
voiceover: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the moon landing than to the building of the pyramids. The Great Pyramid was finished around 2,500 BC. Cleopatra was born in 69 BC. The moon landing happened in 1969. That's about 2,000 years from her to us. And over 2,400 years from her to the pyramids. To Cleopatra, the pyramids were already ancient ruins, older to her than she is to us. History isn't a straight line. It's a long, weird, stretched-out timeline. Follow Mindbloom for one fact a day.
